p='src/cache.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''def make_key(op, entity_id):
    # Build the cache key from the operation name and the entity id
    return f"{op}:{entity_id}"''','''def make_key(tenant_id, op, entity_id):
    # The cache is shared across tenants, so the tenant must be part of the

    return (tenant_id, op, entity_id)''')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='src/service.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''# Clear the whole cache on writes — otherwise users sometimes see other
# tenants' data. Root cause unknown, this is the safe option. DO NOT REMOVE.

# to the DB. If another op leaks, add it here.
_UNCACHED_OPS = frozenset({
    "get_balance",
    "list_open_invoices",
})
''','')
s=s.replace('''        if op in _UNCACHED_OPS:
            self.cache.clear()
            return loader()
        key = make_key(op, entity_id)''','''        key = make_key(tenant_id, op, entity_id)''')
s=s.replace('''    def _after_write(self, tenant_id):
        self.cache.clear()''','''    def _after_write(self, tenant_id):
        # Writes can change any cached read for this tenant; other tenants'

cat >> tests/test_service.py <<'EOF'


def test_summary_not_shared_between_tenants(svc):
    # BILL-2291: same period, no write in between -> must not serve A's cache to B
    a = svc.get_invoice_summary("acme", "2024-05")
    b = svc.get_invoice_summary("globex", "2024-05")
    assert a["total_cents"] == 12_500
    assert b["total_cents"] == 99_900


def test_customer_not_shared_between_tenants(svc):
    assert svc.get_customer("acme", "c-1")["name"] == "Acme Buyer"
    assert svc.get_customer("globex", "c-1")["name"] == "Globex Buyer"


def test_write_only_invalidates_own_tenant(svc):
    svc.get_customer("acme", "c-1")
    svc.get_customer("globex", "c-1")
    q = svc.db.queries
    svc.create_invoice("acme", "inv-7", "c-1", "2024-05", 1)
    svc.get_customer("globex", "c-1")
    assert svc.db.queries == q
    svc.get_customer("acme", "c-1")
    assert svc.db.queries == q + 1


def test_balance_is_cached_per_tenant(svc):
    svc.get_balance("acme", "c-1")
    q = svc.db.queries
    assert svc.get_balance("acme", "c-1") == 12_500
    assert svc.db.queries == q
    assert svc.get_balance("globex", "c-1") == 99_900
EOF
